title: FactoryBot & Capybara
intro: FactoryBot and Capybara are the two most used test support libraries in Rails, and the interview questions are practical rather than conceptual. For FactoryBot the depth markers are: build_stubbed (instantiates a model without touching the database — use this for unit tests to keep them fast), traits for variation, sequences for uniqueness, and the lazy attribute block for dynamic values. For Capybara the depth markers are: the js: true metadata flag that switches to a real browser driver (Selenium/Cuprite), the database-cleaner strategy issue (transactions don't work with JS tests because Capybara runs in a separate thread), and fill_in/click_button/have_text. The database-cleaner section explains transaction vs truncation strategy and when to use each.
